content: # Main Title: Nuclear Fuel Performance ## Subsection: UO2 Base Properties The fluorite-type uranium dioxide (UO2) crystallizes in the face-centered cubic structure. The lattice constant is 5.4704 angstrom and the density is 10.97 g/cm^3. ## Subsection: High-Temperature Behavior The melting point of UO2 is 3120 K. The thermal conductivity at 1000 K is 2.5 W/(m K). The specific heat at 1000 K is 0.320 J/(g K). The bulk modulus is 207.5 GPa.
